_about: Parametric look presets for dwg_look.py. All are DaVinci Wide Gamut / DaVinci Intermediate in -> out. A client look profile (look.example.json) names one of these as its base and overrides any parameter. Parameter meanings: contrast = log-logistic slope of the per-channel filmic curve; grey = display-linear value for scene 18% grey; sat = chroma gain on colorful pixels; sub = subtractive strength (lightness lost per unit chroma gained); cool / warm = split-tone strength in OkLab b units (shadows cool, highlights warm); skin = extra warmth on orange hues; neutral = chroma below which pixels stay untinted (keeps white walls clean).
